current_family_disposition.heading: ## 4. D06 actual costs, literal runtime and selector representation
current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 4. D06 actual costs, literal runtime and selector representation

The later cost chain proves more than a finite proxy estimate. The actual infinite bad count is an increasing supremum of finite-prefix counts, so infinity is allowed at the definition stage and almost-sure finiteness is not assumed circularly. The full generated history fixes prior slot factors. Same-index start cylinders are prefix-free even if starts are arbitrarily late. The product bound does not assume independence of selected intervals or condition on a last bad event. Deterministic raw-prefix deviation bounds transfer to every adaptively acquired history; acquired samples are not simply declared iid.

The earlier quadratic-threshold union bound already supplies all natural moments. The later product/Markov argument gives a two-term exponential tail, with a subsequent affine optimization. Positive separation and finite row data produce the required positive slack and lower constants. Physical time can remain unbounded during zero-cost matching residence. A bad-count tail is not an elapsed completion-time theorem.

The newly recovered original finite-cost characterization also proves an existence-region equivalence: arbitrary-seed finite-mean winning has a deterministic all-natural-moment replacement under the same lawful history interface. It does not say every almost-sure winner has moments. The finite admitted-model family shares a positive open exponential range through a finite minimum; each fixed parameter has a finite supremum bound. The same tolerance and policy precede the true-model quantifier. Extended count-finiteness is separately required because converting infinity to a real number yields zero. The 27 exact historical drafts, controls and mutants are fully qualified in `annex_formal27/`.

The negative cost control is an invalid application of an otherwise valid bound: the substituted parameter must satisfy the actual half-epsilon side condition. Replacing it by the looser epsilon condition fails at the concrete application. This does not refute the cost theorem. Nor does failure of an unchanged closed-range mutation refute every altered existential theorem: shrinking an open rate can produce a closed subinterval. The fixed generic tail endpoint can genuinely diverge. A floor-division mutation likewise breaks the supplied ceiling-event proof while naming a weaker random quantity; proof rejection and mathematical falsity must remain separate.

The literal runtime analysis separates old and computed decoding orientations. A mixed orientation has a positive-measure failure under the actual one-third/two-thirds law. The literal two-configuration result is a disjunction about those exact configurations; it does not identify a unique faulty orientation without the additional evidence. A supplied certified selector gives a conditional family. Classical existence of a selector and a terminating extracted selector implementation remain different claims.

The byte codec is injective on the stated byte domain, not on arbitrary unbounded numeric arrays: carrying can identify arrays such as [0,256] and [1,0]. The LOOP and source-domain proofs preserve all component argument slots and zero padding. They do not create a universal interpreter or resource-independent implementation. Exact history coding can grow exponentially in history length; totality is not practicality. Physical framing counts its actual acquisitions and keeps correlation through the same tape; it does not invent independent channels.

## 5. D08 finite policy certificates and expression execution

The finite certificate checker is sound and complete for existence of a common lawful policy at the declared finite explicit input. The checker examines the submitted finite syntax. Powerset search occurs in the completeness argument and need not be an efficient certificate generator. The polynomial verification argument uses dense explicit input plus certificate size; it is an ordinary cost argument, not a Lean machine-cost proof. A shape-first guard prevents a tiny input with enormous binary dimensions from triggering an unbounded enumeration.

Unchecked merging can hide an invalid duplicate behind a valid row. Checked merge/link validates each input before composition. Parent insertion requires new validation of the parent obligation. The binding envelope compares the entire actual structured input, including interpretation strings. It establishes equality of those supplied fields, not their authenticity or adequacy. It does not combine target components by silently unioning obligations.

The expression machine correspondence concerns the pinned finite expression AST, exact built-in natural-number values, stack behavior, fault order and successful tick count. It does not prove parser correctness, whole-program correspondence, host-exception equivalence, CPU cost or an arbitrary direct-AST interface. `neededBits` has the source's actual behavior, including its treatment of reads; it is not a free preflight oracle.

current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 3. T9 finite executable histories and the continuation interface

The native shared-state primitives use finite first-match lookup with an explicit fallback. Malformed raw memories can be retained while the typed view ignores them. `RoutingMatches` is separate from source authenticity and current authority.

Reconstruction and `replayUpdate` are deliberately guard-free. A forged first row can shadow a later authentic row, and an illegal reconstructed trace can appear to complete. The positive correspondence therefore requires `acceptedStep` and authenticity of each actual input. Finite-history reifiability is an existence result for the declared finite data; arbitrary functions on infinitely many keys are not automatically finite-representable.

Permuting services can preserve the landing count while changing the order of raw acknowledgements. Annotation and reply lengths are checked exactly; the proofs do not silently truncate by `zip`. The ordered native endpoint starts at epoch zero and realizes the 259-event, one-installation, zero-repair trace. Different response streams can make the first landing use nonce1001 or nonce1021 despite the same public program. This is not a confidentiality theorem.

The two-port D16/T9 continuation separates present repair from preservation of the next service. Its exact supply, calibration and future-service premises matter. It does not establish numerical identity or indefinite renewal, and the later T16 renewal/lookahead/synthesis formal closure belongs to the type/collective reader.

Reconstruction and `replayUpdate` are deliberately guard-free. A forged first row can shadow a later authentic row, and an illegal reconstructed trace can appear to complete. The positive correspondence therefore requires `acceptedStep` and authenticity of each actual input. Finite-history reifiability is an existence result for the declared finite data; arbitrary functions on infinitely many keys are not automatically finite-representable.

Permuting services can preserve the landing count while changing the order of raw acknowledgements. Annotation and reply lengths are checked exactly; the proofs do not silently truncate by `zip`. The ordered native endpoint starts at epoch zero and realizes the 259-event, one-installation, zero-repair trace. Different response streams can make the first landing use nonce1001 or nonce1021 despite the same public program. This is not a confidentiality theorem.

The two-port D16/T9 continuation separates present repair from preservation of the next service. Its exact supply, calibration and future-service premises matter. It does not establish numerical identity or indefinite renewal, and the later T16 renewal/lookahead/synthesis formal closure belongs to the type/collective reader.

The criterion-installation chain distinguishes retaining a governing standard, installing a criterion and repairing the governed document. Its positive composition requires the exact shared state and the applicable local guards. A criterion state cannot stand in for a repaired document, and a repair witness cannot retrospectively authorize the installation that preceded it.

Dynamic V2 extends the event model with charged interlocks and cancellation. The finite-history proofs quantify over actual accepted steps, rather than over arbitrary snapshots bearing a success-shaped field. Their scope is safety over arbitrary finite histories. Liveness requires the separately stated service and delivery conditions. Unknown alias classes are represented by their actual root images; displayed labels and path multiplicity do not establish distinct physical roots.

The generic covering portfolio and complete-command search caps are finite combinatorial results relative to a fixed command universe and fixed family. Whole commands include their action, epoch, nonce and other identity-bearing coordinates. Changing one coordinate can produce a new envelope without preserving old acknowledgements. A cover over an assumed universe neither validates that universe nor guarantees future service.

The history V2 repair restricts Reservation to actual valid paths; it does not infer real permission from internal certification. Current acceptance is governed by those repaired source bytes, while failed or bounded predecessor receipts retain their historical status.

current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 2. T8 lifecycle, cancellation, reference clocks and shared-root histories

### Raw epochs and actual alignment

The lifecycle refinement retains raw epochs. Truncated natural-number subtraction can make two raw epochs share a proof index, but the unchanged runtime local-step guard still rejects the lower raw epoch. Index coincidence is therefore not an authorization collision.

Snapshot `RuntimeRepresents` is weaker than the later history invariant: it omits the effective policy. `Aligned` requires authentic complete policy inputs at the specified idle macro boundaries. It does not certify a history before the chosen base point. A shape-only certificate can accept an equal-epoch forged policy while literal alignment fails.

Aggregate calls need not be atomic successes. A failed prepare can leave good-root commitments behind; a later malicious opening can land on that residue. A failed cancellation can nevertheless obtain a durable veto from one good root. Accumulated distinct acknowledgements can meet a certificate threshold even when the current aggregate call returns false. Runtime tombstone lists can grow under repetition while the abstract membership set is idempotent. These are real interfaces between emitted histories and abstract state, not reasons to equate a Boolean return with the whole operation.

### Clock succession

V4 uses a frozen reference clock; V5 adds cancellation; V6 adds monotone reference-clock updates. Structural alignment alone permits a rollback that revives an expired but unlanded envelope. Monotone accepted traces are needed for permanent expiry of that exact envelope. Equal-time stalling and arbitrarily large forward jumps remain permitted. There is no rate or progress theorem. A renewed envelope with a different lease is a different object. Cancellation remains durable even under rollback. The actor's last observed clock is not automatically refreshed when the world's clock changes.

### Shared roots, native batch and protected service

The shared-root controller's scheduled good service windows are stronger than the unchanged four-trial native `runBatch` contract. The seven-label/five-path construction has 21 trials, 252 serviced events and seven synchronization events: 259 total, with exactly one installation and no repair. The first 20 trials yield a 247-event prefix with no effect. Environmental times and replies are attached after the public program is fixed; hidden root maps and fault sets are not actor inputs. This is a source-level nondependence fact, not transcript opacity.

Safety steps alone admit an infinite sequence of holds with no success. The finite bad-store insertion theorem transports the complete good-store state and the exact branch of the source gate, adding the counted corrupt events. It does not cover arbitrary infinite starvation. A weak subset relation between veto sets is insufficient where the current epoch must be shown unrevoked; the explicit revocation bound is load-bearing.

The four-trial batch neither stops early nor refreshes its actor automatically. Its final-survival condition is weaker than freshness of all four attempted keys. Even with zero faulty roots, false cancellation replies from a good root can block each future envelope under the allowed semantics. A numerical cleanup budget is not a liveness premise. A failed earlier delivery can leave tombstones, so restoring delivery does not make retrying the same identity safe.

These results connect T20 history and provenance through exact accepted event streams, full envelope identities, root resolution and current guard state. They do not turn a preserved receipt, copied label or old permission into a new execution authorization.

## 2. T8 lifecycle, cancellation, reference clocks and shared-root histories

### Raw epochs and actual alignment

The lifecycle refinement retains raw epochs. Truncated natural-number subtraction can make two raw epochs share a proof index, but the unchanged runtime local-step guard still rejects the lower raw epoch. Index coincidence is therefore not an authorization collision.

Snapshot `RuntimeRepresents` is weaker than the later history invariant: it omits the effective policy. `Aligned` requires authentic complete policy inputs at the specified idle macro boundaries. It does not certify a history before the chosen base point. A shape-only certificate can accept an equal-epoch forged policy while literal alignment fails.

Aggregate calls need not be atomic successes. A failed prepare can leave good-root commitments behind; a later malicious opening can land on that residue. A failed cancellation can nevertheless obtain a durable veto from one good root. Accumulated distinct acknowledgements can meet a certificate threshold even when the current aggregate call returns false. Runtime tombstone lists can grow under repetition while the abstract membership set is idempotent. These are real interfaces between emitted histories and abstract state, not reasons to equate a Boolean return with the whole operation.

### Clock succession

V4 uses a frozen reference clock; V5 adds cancellation; V6 adds monotone reference-clock updates. Structural alignment alone permits a rollback that revives an expired but unlanded envelope. Monotone accepted traces are needed for permanent expiry of that exact envelope. Equal-time stalling and arbitrarily large forward jumps remain permitted. There is no rate or progress theorem. A renewed envelope with a different lease is a different object. Cancellation remains durable even under rollback. The actor's last observed clock is not automatically refreshed when the world's clock changes.

### Shared roots, native batch and protected service

The shared-root controller's scheduled good service windows are stronger than the unchanged four-trial native `runBatch` contract. The seven-label/five-path construction has 21 trials, 252 serviced events and seven synchronization events: 259 total, with exactly one installation and no repair. The first 20 trials yield a 247-event prefix with no effect. Environmental times and replies are attached after the public program is fixed; hidden root maps and fault sets are not actor inputs. This is a source-level nondependence fact, not transcript opacity.

Safety steps alone admit an infinite sequence of holds with no success. The finite bad-store insertion theorem transports the complete good-store state and the exact branch of the source gate, adding the counted corrupt events. It does not cover arbitrary infinite starvation. A weak subset relation between veto sets is insufficient where the current epoch must be shown unrevoked; the explicit revocation bound is load-bearing.

The four-trial batch neither stops early nor refreshes its actor automatically. Its final-survival condition is weaker than freshness of all four attempted keys. Even with zero faulty roots, false cancellation replies from a good root can block each future envelope under the allowed semantics. A numerical cleanup budget is not a liveness premise. A failed earlier delivery can leave tombstones, so restoring delivery does not make retrying the same identity safe.

These results connect T20 history and provenance through exact accepted event streams, full envelope identities, root resolution and current guard state. They do not turn a preserved receipt, copied label or old permission into a new execution authorization.

current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 2. T8 lifecycle, cancellation, reference clocks and shared-root histories

### Raw epochs and actual alignment

The lifecycle refinement retains raw epochs. Truncated natural-number subtraction can make two raw epochs share a proof index, but the unchanged runtime local-step guard still rejects the lower raw epoch. Index coincidence is therefore not an authorization collision.

Snapshot `RuntimeRepresents` is weaker than the later history invariant: it omits the effective policy. `Aligned` requires authentic complete policy inputs at the specified idle macro boundaries. It does not certify a history before the chosen base point. A shape-only certificate can accept an equal-epoch forged policy while literal alignment fails.

Aggregate calls need not be atomic successes. A failed prepare can leave good-root commitments behind; a later malicious opening can land on that residue. A failed cancellation can nevertheless obtain a durable veto from one good root. Accumulated distinct acknowledgements can meet a certificate threshold even when the current aggregate call returns false. Runtime tombstone lists can grow under repetition while the abstract membership set is idempotent. These are real interfaces between emitted histories and abstract state, not reasons to equate a Boolean return with the whole operation.

### Clock succession

V4 uses a frozen reference clock; V5 adds cancellation; V6 adds monotone reference-clock updates. Structural alignment alone permits a rollback that revives an expired but unlanded envelope. Monotone accepted traces are needed for permanent expiry of that exact envelope. Equal-time stalling and arbitrarily large forward jumps remain permitted. There is no rate or progress theorem. A renewed envelope with a different lease is a different object. Cancellation remains durable even under rollback. The actor's last observed clock is not automatically refreshed when the world's clock changes.

### Shared roots, native batch and protected service

The shared-root controller's scheduled good service windows are stronger than the unchanged four-trial native `runBatch` contract. The seven-label/five-path construction has 21 trials, 252 serviced events and seven synchronization events: 259 total, with exactly one installation and no repair. The first 20 trials yield a 247-event prefix with no effect. Environmental times and replies are attached after the public program is fixed; hidden root maps and fault sets are not actor inputs. This is a source-level nondependence fact, not transcript opacity.

Safety steps alone admit an infinite sequence of holds with no success. The finite bad-store insertion theorem transports the complete good-store state and the exact branch of the source gate, adding the counted corrupt events. It does not cover arbitrary infinite starvation. A weak subset relation between veto sets is insufficient where the current epoch must be shown unrevoked; the explicit revocation bound is load-bearing.

The four-trial batch neither stops early nor refreshes its actor automatically. Its final-survival condition is weaker than freshness of all four attempted keys. Even with zero faulty roots, false cancellation replies from a good root can block each future envelope under the allowed semantics. A numerical cleanup budget is not a liveness premise. A failed earlier delivery can leave tombstones, so restoring delivery does not make retrying the same identity safe.

These results connect T20 history and provenance through exact accepted event streams, full envelope identities, root resolution and current guard state. They do not turn a preserved receipt, copied label or old permission into a new execution authorization.

## 3. T9 finite executable histories and the continuation interface

The native shared-state primitives use finite first-match lookup with an explicit fallback. Malformed raw memories can be retained while the typed view ignores them. `RoutingMatches` is separate from source authenticity and current authority.

Reconstruction and `replayUpdate` are deliberately guard-free. A forged first row can shadow a later authentic row, and an illegal reconstructed trace can appear to complete. The positive correspondence therefore requires `acceptedStep` and authenticity of each actual input. Finite-history reifiability is an existence result for the declared finite data; arbitrary functions on infinitely many keys are not automatically finite-representable.

Permuting services can preserve the landing count while changing the order of raw acknowledgements. Annotation and reply lengths are checked exactly; the proofs do not silently truncate by `zip`. The ordered native endpoint starts at epoch zero and realizes the 259-event, one-installation, zero-repair trace. Different response streams can make the first landing use nonce1001 or nonce1021 despite the same public program. This is not a confidentiality theorem.

The two-port D16/T9 continuation separates present repair from preservation of the next service. Its exact supply, calibration and future-service premises matter. It does not establish numerical identity or indefinite renewal, and the later T16 renewal/lookahead/synthesis formal closure belongs to the type/collective reader.

## 3. T9 finite executable histories and the continuation interface

The native shared-state primitives use finite first-match lookup with an explicit fallback. Malformed raw memories can be retained while the typed view ignores them. `RoutingMatches` is separate from source authenticity and current authority.

Reconstruction and `replayUpdate` are deliberately guard-free. A forged first row can shadow a later authentic row, and an illegal reconstructed trace can appear to complete. The positive correspondence therefore requires `acceptedStep` and authenticity of each actual input. Finite-history reifiability is an existence result for the declared finite data; arbitrary functions on infinitely many keys are not automatically finite-representable.

Permuting services can preserve the landing count while changing the order of raw acknowledgements. Annotation and reply lengths are checked exactly; the proofs do not silently truncate by `zip`. The ordered native endpoint starts at epoch zero and realizes the 259-event, one-installation, zero-repair trace. Different response streams can make the first landing use nonce1001 or nonce1021 despite the same public program. This is not a confidentiality theorem.

The two-port D16/T9 continuation separates present repair from preservation of the next service. Its exact supply, calibration and future-service premises matter. It does not establish numerical identity or indefinite renewal, and the later T16 renewal/lookahead/synthesis formal closure belongs to the type/collective reader.

## 6. T10 completion, occurrence effects and read costs

### Completion and effective boundaries

The compact inverse-limit result relates unique fibres to finite-horizon forgetting under its exact hypotheses. In the nonuniform version there is no single global horizon or convergence rate. Noncompact controls show why the compactness premise cannot be deleted. Computable contractive limits do not make an exact zero/equality boundary uniformly certifiable: the halting reduction survives even with the explicitly constrained maps. Strict robust open properties can still have finite-stage witnesses. The negative equality result does not refute these positive robust certificates.

The broader ordinary completion arguments remain distinct from the compiled uniform and nonuniform components. A theorem naming a certificate is not itself an executable certificate checker or a general source-to-limit adapter.

### Occurrence-preserving effects

The exact stack effect retains minimum entry height, produced symbolic prefix, consumed tail and original-origin references. Composition substitutes those references and combines the height constraints. Keyed exits contribute equality constraints on origin references; contradictions give an empty domain. These objects act on supplied boundary frames and origin resolution, not on unparsed or unauthenticated arbitrary documents.

Copies of the same resolved original root can share one reading obligation. Equal strings with different original roots cannot. Original authorial assertion, grammatical role, quoted voice, present carrier force and current authorization are different coordinates. An old grant does not become a new grant by translation or retransmission.

### Two-card/read-oracle frontier

The exact role-query lower bounds require complete observable locality and the specified permitted menu. Timing, status, selection and other value-dependent disclosures count as channels if they reveal the target. Correlated prior information can change the cost: the target already supplied costs zero; one supplied role can leave one necessary query. A bounded-error randomized one-read success is not a zero-error result. An always-false rule can have high average accuracy and still fail the exact contract.

For the shared-origin three-role conjunction, the fixed middle witness leaves two necessary reads, while an edge witness leaves one. A permitted fixed-target verdict can remove the target's read cost without answering every source-role question. The separately owned D15 normative argument grounds any duty in deliberately organized legitimate reliance and proportionate available response, not in the numerical read cost alone.

### Later occurrence/warrant fixture

The later finite implementation uses eight supplied states and sidecar alphabets of sizes one, two and three. Its exact block counts and encoder census are model facts. The eight work-exclusion maps form the tested idempotent/commutative closed action family; an excluded state is absorbing. Excluding a view is not itself a defeater of the source's authority. The Quran48:9 fixture is a supplied analytical role extraction, including its incomplete row. Running it is not a new Arabic reading, a historical attribution result or a warrant oracle. The grounded-support attestation body is owned by the root mathematical reader; the full T16 report is joined from the type reader.

### Printed and bibliographic witnesses

The accepted Aquinas collation is a bounded pre-web discrepancy finding with attribution unresolved. It does not establish the translators' Latin base, production responsibility, culpability or a complete stemma. Both printed PDFs have now been recovered from their recorded public URLs with exact historical hashes, and title, target, apparatus/sigla and reply pages were visually inspected. The negative English concession, positive Leonine main reading and negative apparatus variant are directly corroborated. A fresh replay of the recorded Wayback timestamp agrees at the target occurrence but has different bytes from the old capture. The objection and the separate authorial reply retain distinct roles. See `source_witness_recovery/FRESH_READING.json`. The Billon record distinguishes bibliographic identity, proof-marked witness identity and final publication identity. The foundations reader's current access recheck still leaves the complete article and Appendix A unavailable. Selected indexed passages are not a continuous whole-paper reading. No new global refutation or final-version claim is inferred.

## 6. T10 completion, occurrence effects and read costs

### Completion and effective boundaries

The compact inverse-limit result relates unique fibres to finite-horizon forgetting under its exact hypotheses. In the nonuniform version there is no single global horizon or convergence rate. Noncompact controls show why the compactness premise cannot be deleted. Computable contractive limits do not make an exact zero/equality boundary uniformly certifiable: the halting reduction survives even with the explicitly constrained maps. Strict robust open properties can still have finite-stage witnesses. The negative equality result does not refute these positive robust certificates.

The broader ordinary completion arguments remain distinct from the compiled uniform and nonuniform components. A theorem naming a certificate is not itself an executable certificate checker or a general source-to-limit adapter.

### Occurrence-preserving effects

The exact stack effect retains minimum entry height, produced symbolic prefix, consumed tail and original-origin references. Composition substitutes those references and combines the height constraints. Keyed exits contribute equality constraints on origin references; contradictions give an empty domain. These objects act on supplied boundary frames and origin resolution, not on unparsed or unauthenticated arbitrary documents.

Copies of the same resolved original root can share one reading obligation. Equal strings with different original roots cannot. Original authorial assertion, grammatical role, quoted voice, present carrier force and current authorization are different coordinates. An old grant does not become a new grant by translation or retransmission.

### Two-card/read-oracle frontier

The exact role-query lower bounds require complete observable locality and the specified permitted menu. Timing, status, selection and other value-dependent disclosures count as channels if they reveal the target. Correlated prior information can change the cost: the target already supplied costs zero; one supplied role can leave one necessary query. A bounded-error randomized one-read success is not a zero-error result. An always-false rule can have high average accuracy and still fail the exact contract.

For the shared-origin three-role conjunction, the fixed middle witness leaves two necessary reads, while an edge witness leaves one. A permitted fixed-target verdict can remove the target's read cost without answering every source-role question. The separately owned D15 normative argument grounds any duty in deliberately organized legitimate reliance and proportionate available response, not in the numerical read cost alone.

### Later occurrence/warrant fixture

The later finite implementation uses eight supplied states and sidecar alphabets of sizes one, two and three. Its exact block counts and encoder census are model facts. The eight work-exclusion maps form the tested idempotent/commutative closed action family; an excluded state is absorbing. Excluding a view is not itself a defeater of the source's authority. The Quran48:9 fixture is a supplied analytical role extraction, including its incomplete row. Running it is not a new Arabic reading, a historical attribution result or a warrant oracle. The grounded-support attestation body is owned by the root mathematical reader; the full T16 report is joined from the type reader.

### Printed and bibliographic witnesses

The accepted Aquinas collation is a bounded pre-web discrepancy finding with attribution unresolved. It does not establish the translators' Latin base, production responsibility, culpability or a complete stemma. Both printed PDFs have now been recovered from their recorded public URLs with exact historical hashes, and title, target, apparatus/sigla and reply pages were visually inspected. The negative English concession, positive Leonine main reading and negative apparatus variant are directly corroborated. A fresh replay of the recorded Wayback timestamp agrees at the target occurrence but has different bytes from the old capture. The objection and the separate authorial reply retain distinct roles. See `source_witness_recovery/FRESH_READING.json`. The Billon record distinguishes bibliographic identity, proof-marked witness identity and final publication identity. The foundations reader's current access recheck still leaves the complete article and Appendix A unavailable. Selected indexed passages are not a continuous whole-paper reading. No new global refutation or final-version claim is inferred.

## 7. T11 typed contexts, substitution and recursive dependent All

All four T11 suites and their required original P01 proof bodies have been examined, with three earlier exact full-body credits reused explicitly. They were freshly compiled as one isolated 100-module union without candidate object reuse.

The raw-index countermodel is substantive: an unformed replacement involving a parameter-dependent sigma/identity can relate unequal valuations while failing the needed right diagonal. `ImageMatch` therefore needs formation and both endpoint diagonals. Mixed type images may depend on the full target term context, and the induced parameter PER may vary with the valuation. A pointwise unary reading is too weak.

Finite substitution syntax supplies zero-padded total term images and Bottom outside supported type parameters. Its identity is scoped. It is not literal equality between the padded total image and the infinite variable function. The binder tests cover both type and term binders, dependent sigma and both contextual-J coordinates.

The typed telescope nucleus retains arbitrary PER-valued domains and supplies universal heterogeneous soundness from syntax-generated formation/typing evidence. Its restricted legacy comparison does not silently recover every old All derivation. Recursive dependent All later adds the genuine recursive constructor and mixed semantic substitution, while the old Prop-valued conversion relation remains unchanged.

The full old-rule comparison carries a Type-valued derivation tree with support for displayed premises, replacement types, motives and endpoints. This is not a reifier from arbitrary Prop-valued derivations, and it does not reveal internal transitivity witnesses hidden in a conversion proof. The original core's All introduction has a semantic uniformity premise; the later syntactic construction proves the required uniformity in its own grammar.

Normalization candidates and backward-conversion-closed semantic codes must also remain distinct. Backward closure can admit a term that discards a divergent argument. Strong normalization of a chosen finite syntax does not imply normalization or finite-source reification of every semantic inhabitant. The I/SKK, raw-fibre, contextual-J and polymorphic self-instantiation controls preserve those boundaries rather than identifying all semantic codes with finite source syntax.

current_family_disposition.heading: ## 8. T18 one irreversible hidden change
current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 8. T18 one irreversible hidden change

The positive finite criterion uses the known and uncertain regions with their actual overlap and empty-region conventions. It relies on the common action menu. Uncertainty uses the appropriate old-mode closure, and a revelation is accepted only at a permitted new-mode transition. Nonrevealing choices must match full relevant rows, not merely supports or minimum priorities.

The actual adversary sees the chosen action, then decides whether to switch irreversibly, before the new receipt is drawn. The policy sees public history and its private independent seed; it does not see the hidden tag. Fixed-index/no-change equivalence with adaptive switching is proved by a countable selection on the same complete random stack. It does not assume that a selected tail remains iid after conditioning on a stopping decision.

Necessity covers every admitted measurable private-seed policy, including policies beyond finite memory. Positive-prefix normalization cancels the common action-compatible seed mass; it does not make claims about actions selected with zero probability. Late switching preserves the old prefix even when its new-mode probability is zero. Killed-law recurrence transfer uses a deterministic confinement index and avoids conditioning on a non-stopping last exit.

The constructed winner discharges the actual history/law/recurrence requirements. All-history lawfulness is separate from almost-sure parity: null-seed and off-policy histories still require lawful choices. Retained old counts, strict count thresholds and phase arithmetic matter. A wrong candidate can persist when its recurrent rows match the actual rows. No finite learning-time, finite-memory, error-budget or finite expected recovery-cost guarantee follows.

Representation changes alter the effectivity statement:

- Explicit finite rational input gives the stated P-completeness result. Priority thresholds and the MEC decomposition keep the finite decision procedure polynomial; the hardness reduction has its actual acyclic monotone-circuit semantics.
- Each positive arbitrary-real instance has an effective winner nonuniformly, using finite instance-dependent support/equality and separating data.
- A total exact algorithm from arbitrary fast-Cauchy names is obstructed even for rational-valued rows, because exact equality is undecidable in that representation.
- Common priorities permit one support-based policy before numerical kernels are fixed. Positive-support inclusion is enough for the one-sided test; the controller does not claim to learn exact zeros.
- Hidden mode-dependent priorities need additional calibration. Swapped numerical orientations can produce the same support/equality data and indistinguishable observation laws with opposite eventual action requirements.

The Python reference and efficient implementations use exact Fractions and explicit certificate checks. Their canonical simple-route format differs from Lean's bounded-walk format; strict Python descent differs from the allowed repeated terminal certificate. There is no proved Python/Lean representation or runtime correspondence. A mutable incremental memory object also has a stronger trusted same-model construction boundary than the public arbitrary-history API.

current_family_disposition.heading: ## 8. T18 one irreversible hidden change
current_family_disposition.current_semantic_disposition:
## 8. T18 one irreversible hidden change

The positive finite criterion uses the known and uncertain regions with their actual overlap and empty-region conventions. It relies on the common action menu. Uncertainty uses the appropriate old-mode closure, and a revelation is accepted only at a permitted new-mode transition. Nonrevealing choices must match full relevant rows, not merely supports or minimum priorities.

The actual adversary sees the chosen action, then decides whether to switch irreversibly, before the new receipt is drawn. The policy sees public history and its private independent seed; it does not see the hidden tag. Fixed-index/no-change equivalence with adaptive switching is proved by a countable selection on the same complete random stack. It does not assume that a selected tail remains iid after conditioning on a stopping decision.

Necessity covers every admitted measurable private-seed policy, including policies beyond finite memory. Positive-prefix normalization cancels the common action-compatible seed mass; it does not make claims about actions selected with zero probability. Late switching preserves the old prefix even when its new-mode probability is zero. Killed-law recurrence transfer uses a deterministic confinement index and avoids conditioning on a non-stopping last exit.

The constructed winner discharges the actual history/law/recurrence requirements. All-history lawfulness is separate from almost-sure parity: null-seed and off-policy histories still require lawful choices. Retained old counts, strict count thresholds and phase arithmetic matter. A wrong candidate can persist when its recurrent rows match the actual rows. No finite learning-time, finite-memory, error-budget or finite expected recovery-cost guarantee follows.

Representation changes alter the effectivity statement:

- Explicit finite rational input gives the stated P-completeness result. Priority thresholds and the MEC decomposition keep the finite decision procedure polynomial; the hardness reduction has its actual acyclic monotone-circuit semantics.
- Each positive arbitrary-real instance has an effective winner nonuniformly, using finite instance-dependent support/equality and separating data.
- A total exact algorithm from arbitrary fast-Cauchy names is obstructed even for rational-valued rows, because exact equality is undecidable in that representation.
- Common priorities permit one support-based policy before numerical kernels are fixed. Positive-support inclusion is enough for the one-sided test; the controller does not claim to learn exact zeros.
- Hidden mode-dependent priorities need additional calibration. Swapped numerical orientations can produce the same support/equality data and indistinguishable observation laws with opposite eventual action requirements.

The Python reference and efficient implementations use exact Fractions and explicit certificate checks. Their canonical simple-route format differs from Lean's bounded-walk format; strict Python descent differs from the allowed repeated terminal certificate. There is no proved Python/Lean representation or runtime correspondence. A mutable incremental memory object also has a stronger trusted same-model construction boundary than the public arbitrary-history API.

records.title: Typed emergence control separating intrinsic acts from created effects

assumptions: Obj constructors distinguish ground, gAct(n), effect(n) and other(n); E, rather than mere membership in the potential-label domain, marks existence at a world.
Power and all-world existence of the ground are explicit interpretation inputs; GAct and capacity are predicates, not additional objects.
R(w,v) is the chosen strict serial-order relation. The actual trajectory is separately stipulated and is not inferred from modal availability.
Created and ExternalReceipt extensions are explicitly selected for this model; no universal theory of creation or every form of intrinsic dependence is thereby proved.
inherited_registered_statement.conclusion: A chosen typed interpretation distinguishes essential bearer power, an act-kind predicate, successive intrinsic act tokens and created effects. It realises possible G-empty and stronger all-emergent-empty alternatives together with box-diamond availability of genuinely fresh, existent G tokens. Its separately chosen actual trajectory has a total emergent gap followed by a distinct new act; every occurring emergent token permanently ceases. A temporally novel intrinsic act can produce a created effect without itself satisfying Created or the model’s ExternalReceipt predicate. Exactly one stipulated object is all-world necessary; this is a representation control, not an actual metaphysical existence or possibility proof.
inherited_registered_statement.input_contract: Obj constructors distinguish ground, gAct(n), effect(n) and other(n); E, rather than mere membership in the potential-label domain, marks existence at a world.; Power and all-world existence of the ground are explicit interpretation inputs; GAct and capacity are predicates, not additional objects.; R(w,v) is the chosen strict serial-order relation. The actual trajectory is separately stipulated and is not inferred from modal availability.; Created and ExternalReceipt extensions are explicitly selected for this model; no universal theory of creation or every form of intrinsic dependence is thereby proved.
limitations: Emergent is a kind predicate; concrete temporal novelty is separately witnessed through E at different actual states.
The auxiliary other-kind is possible in some worlds but absent on the selected actual trajectory; its actual cessation case is vacuous. G-act and effect occurrences are live.
A chosen singleton necessary-object extension does not prove actual numerical uniqueness, a second necessary abstract type, or the metaphysical adequacy of the frame.
Safadiyya supports the intrinsic-act/created-product distinction. It does not by itself attribute historical simultaneous cessation of all emergent kinds.

Applying OriginalBearerBridge.ContingencyNeed to novel intrinsic act tokens requires an additional B-admission and whole-existence applicability assumption; the inherited conditional proof remains intact.
Metaphysical possibility, actual realization, empirical cosmology, source-authentication and full divine-action semantics remain unproved.
The 14:34 Necessary Being/actual common-source appraisal is unchanged; universal SourceMode remains withheld.
This clarifies an application-scope assumption, not a discovered failure of the old B conditional.

The 2026-10-07 source-context successor limits historical application: capacity with global inactivity does not preserve the stronger always-active or anti-inactivity commitments at the audited Nisāʾ lesson 33 and al-Ṣafadiyya loci. This is separate from per-kind absence or token cessation, and does not alter the chosen model's formal conclusion or original scientific anchors.

The renewed-act/created-effect distinction does not make every renewed intrinsic act an externally received essential perfection. The source-context refinement supplies no new Lean execution, full-premise countermodel, metaphysical possibility certificate or universal SourceMode warrant.
